verdict.rationale: Batch or bulk generation is a fair capability to ask of a video-generation model and API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents bulk operations across many items. The docs cover single-prompt generation and multi-turn refinement via the Interactions API, and the one community report of making 12 videos describes separate runs, not a bulk feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
